Name: Banners Expanded
Author: Sha425
Description:
[center][/center]
[size=6][b]About this mod[/b][/size]

[b]Huge thanks for 12000+ downloads. Thanks for your support!

[🇬🇧] [/b]This mod expands your decoration options by adding a variety of unique, thematic banners to the game. From celestial bodies to seasonal celebrations, these banners are designed to fit perfectly into your farmhouse or sheds.

[center][/center]
[b][🇷🇺][/b] Этот мод расширяет ваши возможности для декорирования, добавляя в игру множество уникальных тематических баннеров. От небесных светил до сезонных праздников – эти баннеры созданы специально для того, чтобы идеально вписаться в интерьер вашего дома или сараев.
[line]
[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]New Furniture Items:[/b] Adds 16+ custom banners with unique sprites.[/*]
[*][b]Thematic Designs:[/b] Includes Moon, Sun, Dragon, Mushroom, and Seasonal (Spring, Winter Star, Harvest) banners.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]🚩 Full List of Banners[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Moon & Sun Banners:[/b] Celestial aesthetics for your walls (Moon in Catalogue №1, Sun in Catalogue №2 (SVE)).[/*]
[*][b]Dragon Banner:[/b] A fierce and legendary addition to any room which can be purchased from Marlon.[/*]
[*][b]Geode Banner:[/b] A special reward for miners (dropped from Omni Geodes).[/*]
[*]﻿﻿[b]Mushroom Banner:[/b] A cozy decoration for your forest-themed interiors that can be bought at the Stardew Valley Fair for star tokens.[/*]
[*][b]Spring Banner:[/b] Celebrate the season of renewal with floral motifs available for purchase at the Flower Dance.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest Banner:[/b] A warm design to showcase your autumn bounty that can be bought from Pierre during the Fall season.[/*]
[*][b]Winter Star Banner:[/b] Festive decor to bring warmth to the cold winter nights received as a gift in the mail on Winter 25 of Year 2.[/*]
[*][b]Star Banner: [/b]A celestial masterpiece featuring shimmering golden stars (Purchasable at the Night Market blue boat).[/*]
[*][b]Bird Banner:[/b] A symbol of freedom and bright colors handmade by Emily once you reach a 5-heart friendship level with her.[/*]
[*][b]Chicken Banner:[/b] A heartwarming tribute to Shane's blue chickens received after his 8-heart event.[/*]
[*][b]Tropical Banner:[/b] A rare island treasure found only inside Golden Coconuts. [/*]
[*][b]Fish Banner:[/b] A mark of true craftsmanship, sent by Willy once you've caught 100 fish.[/*]
[*][b]Desert Banner:[/b] A sun-soaked souvenir from the scorching sands, available at the Desert Festival in exchange for Calico Eggs. [/*]
[*][b]Pearl Banner:[/b] An elegant tribute to the deep sea mysteries, awarded for solving the Mermaid's musical puzzle at the Night Market. [/*]
[*][b]Mom's Banner:[/b] A heartwarming gift from home, received by mail on your first wedding anniversary. [b][i]NEW![/i][/b][/*]
[*][b]Summer Banner:[/b] [b]Summer Banner:[/b] A bright, floral decoration available for purchase at Pierre’s Luau shop. [b][i]NEW![/i][/b]
[/*]
[/list][size=5]🌐 [b]Supported Languages[/b][/size]
Includes native support for 10 languages!
[list]
[*][b]English[/b] [🇬🇧][/*]
[*][b]Russian[/b] [🇷🇺][/*]
[*][b]German[/b] [🇩🇪][/*]
[*][b]Spanish[/b] [🇪🇸][/*]
[*][b]French[/b] [🇫🇷][/*]
[*][b]Japanese[/b] [🇯🇵][/*]
[*][b]Polish[/b] [🇵🇱][/*]
[*][b]Portuguese[/b] [🇧🇷][/*]
[*][b]Vietnamese[/b] [🇻🇳][/*]
[*][b]Chinese[/b] [🇨🇳][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]⚙️ Requirements
[/b][/size]This mod requires the following to function correctly:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (Required)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url] (Recommended)[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]
📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (Not Required, but Recommended)[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list][line]
